2670-love-songs-of-childhood.title: Love Songs Of Childhood
2670-love-songs-of-childhood.creator: Eugene Field
2670-love-songs-of-childhood.description: A book by Eugene Field. There is one little dream of a beautiful drum--  "Rub-a-dub!" it goeth;  There is one little dream of a big sugar-plum,  And lo! thick and fast the other dreams come  Of popguns that bang, and tin tops that hum,  And a trumpet that bloweth!

arxiv-2012-00959.title: Local Routing in a Tree Metric 1-Spanner
arxiv-2012-00959.creator: Milutin Brankovic, Joachim Gudmundsson, André van Renssen
arxiv-2012-00959.description: Abstract Solomon and Elkin [ 14 ] constructed a shortcutting scheme for weighted trees which results in a 1-spanner for the tree metric induced by the input tree. The spanner has logarithmic lightness, logarithmic diameter, a linear number of edges and bounded degree (provided the input tree has bounded degree).

arxiv-2112-03289.title: Star formation in outer rings of S0 galaxies.
arxiv-2112-03289.creator: Ivan Yu. Katkov, Alexei Yu. Kniazev, Olga K. Sil’chenko, Damir Gasymov
arxiv-2112-03289.description: Abstract Aims. Although S0 galaxies are usually considered “red and dead”, they often demonstrate star formation organized into ring structures. We aim to clarify the nature of this phenomenon and how it differs from star formation in spiral galaxies. Methods.

arxiv-2202-01139.title: Surrogate Modeling for Physical Systems with Preserved Properties and Adjustable Tradeoffs
arxiv-2202-01139.creator: Randi Wang, Morad Behandish
arxiv-2202-01139.description: Abstract Determining the proper level of details to develop and solve physical models is usually difficult when one encounters new engineering problems. Such difficulty comes from how to balance the time (simulation cost) and accuracy for the physical model simulation afterwards.

arxiv-2202-12566.title: Composing Complex and Hybrid AI Solutions
arxiv-2202-12566.creator: Peter Schüller, João Paulo Costeira, James Crowley, Jasmin Grosinger, Félix Ingrand, Uwe Köckemann, Alessandro Saffiotti, Martin Welss
arxiv-2202-12566.description: Abstract Progress in several areas of computer science has been enabled by comfortable and efficient means of experimentation, clear interfaces, and interchangable components, for example using OpenCV for computer vision or ROS for robotics. We describe an extension of the Acumos system towards enabling the above features for general AI applications.

arxiv-2203-07046.title: Bi-accessible and bipresentable 2-categories
arxiv-2203-07046.creator: Ivan Di Liberti Axel Osmond
arxiv-2203-07046.description: Abstract We develop a 2-dimensional version of accessibility and presentability compatible with the formalism of flat pseudofunctors. First we give prerequisites on the different notions of 2-dimensional colimits, filteredness and cofinality; in particular we show that σ \sigma -filteredness and bifilteredness are actually equivalent in practice for our purposes.

arxiv-2311-13568.title: Learning from similar systems and online data-driven LQR using iterative randomised data compression
arxiv-2311-13568.creator: Vatsal Kedia, Sneha Susan George, Debraj Chakraborty
arxiv-2311-13568.description: Abstract The problem of data driven recursive computation of receding horizon LQR control through a randomized combination of online/current and historical/recorded data, is considered. It is assumed that large amounts of historical input-output data from a system, which is similar but not identical to the current system under consideration, is available.

arxiv-2401-14873.title: Lessons from discrete light-cone quantization for physics at null infinity: Bosons in two dimensions
arxiv-2401-14873.creator: Glenn Barnich, Sucheta Majumdar, Simone Speziale, Wen-Di Tan
arxiv-2401-14873.description: Abstract Lessons from discrete light-cone quantization for physics at null infinity: Bosons in two dimensions Glenn Barnich a , Sucheta Majumdar b , Simone Speziale c , Wen-Di Tan a a Physique Théorique et Mathématique Université libre de Bruxelles and International Solvay Institutes Campus Plaine C.P. 231, B-1050 Bruxelles, Belgium E-mail: Glenn.Barnich@ulb.be , wendi.tan@ulb.

arxiv-2404-02109.title: The Effects of Group Sanctions on Participation and Toxicity: Quasi-experimental Evidence from the Fediverse
arxiv-2404-02109.creator: Carl Colglazier 1 , Nathan TeBlunthuis 2 , Aaron Shaw 1
arxiv-2404-02109.description: Abstract Online communities often overlap and coexist, despite incongruent norms and approaches to content moderation. When communities diverge, decentralized and federated communities may pursue group-level sanctions, including defederation (disconnection) to block communication between members of specific communities. We investigate the effects of defederation in the context of the Fediverse, a set of decentralized, interconnected social networks with independent governance.

arxiv-2408-00921.title: Automatic Pull Request Description Generation Using LLMs: A T5 Model Approach
arxiv-2408-00921.creator: Md Nazmus Sakib, Md Athikul Islam, Md Mashrur Arifin
arxiv-2408-00921.description: Abstract Developers create pull request (PR) descriptions to provide an overview of their changes and explain the motivations behind them. These descriptions help reviewers and fellow developers quickly understand the updates. Despite their importance, some developers omit these descriptions. To tackle this problem, we propose an automated method for generating PR descriptions based on commit messages and source code comments.

arxiv-2411-03827.title: DesignMinds: Enhancing Video-Based Design Ideation with Vision-Language Model and Context-Injected Large Language Model
arxiv-2411-03827.creator: Tianhao He, Andrija Stanković, Evangelos Niforatos, Gerd Kortuem
arxiv-2411-03827.description: Abstract . Ideation is a critical component of video-based design (VBD), where videos serve as the primary medium for design exploration and inspiration. The emergence of generative AI offers considerable potential to enhance this process by streamlining video analysis and facilitating idea generation.

arxiv-2501-00024.title: LoRaFlow: High-Quality Signal Reconstruction using Rectified Flow
arxiv-2501-00024.creator: Tamer Nadeem
arxiv-2501-00024.description: Abstract LoRa technology, crucial for low-power wide-area networks, faces significant performance degradation at extremely low signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs). We present LoRaFlow, a novel approach using rectified flow to reconstruct high-quality LoRa signals in challenging noise conditions. Unlike existing neural-enhanced methods focused on classification, LoRaFlow recovers the signal itself, maintaining compatibility with standard dechirp algorithms.

arxiv-2501-17077.title: Inducing, Detecting and Characterising Neural Modules: A Pipeline for Functional Interpretability in Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2501-17077.creator: Anna Soligo, Pietro Ferraro, David Boyle
arxiv-2501-17077.description: Abstract Interpretability is crucial for ensuring RL systems align with human values. However, it remains challenging to achieve in complex decision making domains. Existing methods frequently attempt interpretability at the level of fundamental model units, such as neurons or decision nodes: an approach which scales poorly to large models.

arxiv-2503-22398.title: DF-Net: The Digital Forensics Network for Image Forgery Detection
arxiv-2503-22398.creator: David Fischinger and Martin Boyer
arxiv-2503-22398.description: Abstract The orchestrated manipulation of public opinion, particularly through manipulated images, often spread via online social networks (OSN), has become a serious threat to society. In this paper we introduce the Digital Forensics Net (DF-Net), a deep neural network for pixel-wise image forgery detection. The released model outperforms several state-of-the-art methods on four established benchmark datasets.

arxiv-2507-00581.title: Non-spectrality of some piecewise smooth curves and unions of line segments
arxiv-2507-00581.creator: Mihail N. Kolountzakis, Chun-Kit Lai
arxiv-2507-00581.description: Abstract . We develop a systematic study about the spectrality of measures supported on piecewise smooth curves by studying the support of the tempered distributions arising from the tiling equation of some singular spectral measures. In doing so, we show that the arc-length measures of all closed polygonal lines are not spectral.

europmc-pmc3020924.creator: Mikell I, Sather DN, Kalams SA, Altfeld M, Alter G, Stamatatos L.
europmc-pmc3020924.description: Recent cross-sectional analyses of HIV-1+ plasmas have indicated that broadly cross-reactive neutralizing antibody responses are developed by 10%-30% of HIV-1+ subjects. The timing of the initial development of such anti-viral responses is unknown. It is also unknown whether the

pmc-11494914.title: Bayesian sparse regression for exposure–response analyses of efficacy and safety endpoints to justify the clinical dose of valemetostat for adult T‐cell leukemia/lymphoma
pmc-11494914.creator: Masato Fukae, James Rogers, Ramon Garcia, Masaya Tachibana, Takako Shimizu
pmc-11494914.description: Valemetostat is an oral inhibitor of enhancer of zeste homolog (EZH) 2 and EZH1 approved in Japan for the treatment of adult T‐cell leukemia/lymphoma (ATLL). To support the approved daily dose of 200 mg and inform dose adjustments in patients with ATLL, Bayesian exposure–response analyses were conducted using data from two clinical trials.

pmc-11696640.title: Hydrogen storage properties of TiFe-based composite with Ni addition
pmc-11696640.creator: Hao Sun, Ziqiang Yan, Zhonggang Han, Jiaxin Li, Tingting Zhai, Zeming Yuan, Tao Li, Jin Xu, Yanghuan Zhang
pmc-11696640.description: This paper presents the preparation of the parental experimental alloy, featuring a standard composition of Ti1.08Y0.02Zr0.1Fe0.7Ni0.3Mn0.2, via the vacuum induction melting technique. Subsequently, the Ti1.08Y0.02Zr0.1Fe0.7Ni0.3Mn0.2 alloy, with an addition of 2 wt% Ni, underwent mechanical ball milling to yield a TiFe-based composite for experimental purposes.

pmc-11709463.title: Specific expression of APOE in astrocytes reduces Aβ accumulation and plaque‐related pathology in a mouse model of amyloidosis
pmc-11709463.creator: NA WANG, Sydney V Doss, Yuzhou Chang, William Tauer, Yingxue Ren, Fangfang Qi, Guojun Bu, Chia‐Chen Liu, Long‐Jun Wu
pmc-11709463.description: BackgroundAccumulation of the amyloid‐β (Aβ) peptide into amyloid plaque is one of the key pathological markers of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Apolipoprotein E (APOE) is known to modify AD risk and has been reported to influence Aβ accumulation in the brain in an isoform‐dependent manner.

pmc-12398080.title: Analysing YouTube as a health resource: quality and reliability of videos on pediatric appendicitis
pmc-12398080.creator: Nurcan Çoşkun, Emre Demir
pmc-12398080.description: BackgroundThis study aims to assess the content, quality, and reliability of YouTube videos related to appendicitis in children. It analyzes the extent to which these videos provide accurate information to parents and healthcare professionals and evaluates their potential contribution to improving the quality of medical education.

pmc-12552394.title: Prognostic value of baseline body composition parameters from 18F-FDG PET/CT in angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma patients
pmc-12552394.creator: Huanyu Gong, Jingjie Shang, Jianyong Li, Chongyang Ding, Hao Xu, Lijun Tang, Yong Cheng
pmc-12552394.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This retrospective study investigated preliminarily the prognostic value of body composition parameters derived from baseline 18F-FDG PET/CT in angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (AITL) patients. We included 94 treatment-naïve AITL patients diagnosed by histopathology. Based on the axial CT images of the third lumbar vertebra, the areas of skeletal muscle (SM), visceral adipose tissue (VAT), and subcutaneous adipose tissue (SAT) were semi-automatically delineated and standardized to finally obtain SM index (SMI), VAT index (VATI), and SAT index (SATI).

pmc-12838384.title: Oxidative Stress and Inflammatory Biomarkers in Aqueous Humor and Blood of Patients with Leber’s Hereditary Optic Neuropathy
pmc-12838384.creator: Berta Sánchez-Fernández, Pablo Zamorano-González, Elisa Martín-Montañez, Carmen Alba-Linero, Francisca Rius-Díaz, María García-Fernandez, Rafael Luque-Aranda, Ignacio García-Basterra
pmc-12838384.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Leber’s hereditary optic neuropathy (LHON) is a mitochondrial disorder that causes visual impairment due to the degeneration of retinal ganglion cells. Oxidative stress (OS) and inflammatory cytokines have been implicated in its pathophysiology. We investigated, for the first time, the presence of OS biomarkers and inflammatory cytokines in the aqueous humor and peripheral blood of LHON patients compared to controls, aiming to identify potential clinical biomarkers for diagnosis and disease monitoring.

pmc-13229680.title: Hyperspectral estimation of leaf chlorophyll under small-sample conditions via spectral augmentation and weighted ensemble learning
pmc-13229680.creator: Jiahui Xu, Yalong Song, Yuanyuan Liu, Shuo Zhang, Guansan Zhu, Wentao Li, Xufeng Wang, Jianfei Xing
pmc-13229680.description: IntroductionUnder small-sample conditions, hyperspectral leaf chlorophyll estimation is affected by high-dimensional collinearity, measurement noise, and cross-source acquisition discrepancies. Existing studies often treat training-distribution expansion and model-error complementarity separately. This study proposed a physically constrained composite spectral augmentation–weighted ensemble framework for reproducible small-sample chlorophyll estimation.

pmc-13324666.title: Critical care considerations in rhabdomyolysis-associated acute kidney injury and kidney replacement therapy
pmc-13324666.creator: Faith Hui Ai Wong, Kay Choong See
pmc-13324666.description: Rhabdomyolysis is a frequently seen and potentially severe condition in intensive care, resulting from causes like trauma, infection, drug toxicity, or prolonged immobility. When muscle cells break down, substances such as myoglobin enter the bloodstream, increasing the risk of acute kidney injury (AKI), which greatly affects patient outcomes.

pmc-13415681.title: Striatal neuron dysfunction in C9ORF72-FTD/ALS is driven by AIS and potassium channel dysregulation
pmc-13415681.creator: Iris-Stefania Pasniceanu, Manpreet S. Atwal, Cleide Dos Santos Souza, Tobias Moll, Marianne King, Connie Treanor, Daniel Cabezas de la Fuente, Ryan J.H. West, Laura Ferraiuolo, Matthew R. Livesey
pmc-13415681.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryFrontotemporal dementia (FTD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) form a neurodegenerative spectrum characterized by progressive cognitive, behavioral, and motor decline, yet the contribution of the striatum to disease pathophysiology remains poorly understood. Here, we generate inhibitory striatal medium spiny neurons (MSNs) from human induced pluripotent stem cells carrying the C9ORF72 repeat expansion, the most common genetic cause of FTD/ALS, and compare them with isogenic-corrected, control, and patient-derived motor neurons.

pmc-13629110.description: Set against the backdrop of a competitive and demanding academic environment in China, this study reconceptualizes the small talk of early-career female academics through a sociocultural psychological lens. pmc-13672103.title: Single-molecule chromatin tracing reveals a diversity of megabase heterochromatin domains
pmc-13672103.creator: Dania Camila Pulido-Barrera, Jia E. You, Angelo L. Angonezi, Alexander Kuznetsov, Fei Xu, Tobias Verheijen, Ahilya N. Saw, Pavel Kos, Luca Giorgetti, Nacho Molina, David Brückner, Susan E. Mango
